name: Compile parc-stats csvs across project into one dataframe
summary: Concatenates a chosen parc-stats CSV from many subjects into one group table with pandas, adding subject, session and tag columns, for group analysis.
description: For every selected parc-stats dataset, reads <csv_name>.csv, adds subjectID, sessionID, tags and datatype_tags columns from the dataset metadata when missing, and stacks all rows into parc_stats.csv. Use it to gather per-subject parcellation statistics across a project before group statistics.

inputs.description: Parcellation statistics datasets (multi), one per subject or session.
inputs.requirements: Each must contain a CSV named <csv_name>.csv.

outputs.description: Group table parc_stats.csv combining the rows of all inputs with subject, session and tag columns.

parameters.description: Base name (without .csv) of the CSV file to read from each parc-stats input.
